control_3.xSQL:
select distinct xqa.quota_id, xqa.amount quarterly_quota_amount
from xc_quota_assignment xqa 
  inner join xc_period quota_period on xqa.period_id = quota_period.period_id
  inner join xc_period_type quota_period_type on quota_period.period_type_id_fk = quota_period_type.period_type_id
  inner join xc_period quota_effective_start on xqa.effective_start_period_id = quota_effective_start.period_id
  inner join xc_period quota_effective_end on xqa.effective_end_period_id = quota_effective_end.period_id
 
where 
  	xqa.assignment_id = :v_master_position_id -- '29501695119'
    and quota_period_type.name  = 'QUARTERLY'
    and quota_effective_start.start_date <= (select end_date from xc_period where name =  :v_current_period)
    and quota_effective_end.end_date >= (select start_date from xc_period where name =  :v_current_period) 
	and quota_period.start_date <= (select end_date from xc_period where name = :v_current_period)
  	and quota_period.end_date >= (select start_date from xc_period where name = :v_current_period)"
"select distinct xqa.quota_id, xqa.assignment_id, xqa.amount yearly_quota_amount
from xc_quota_assignment xqa

  inner join xc_period quota_effective_start on xqa.effective_start_period_id = quota_effective_start.period_id
  inner join xc_period quota_effective_end on xqa.effective_end_period_id = quota_effective_end.period_id
where

   and quota_effective_start.start_date <= (select end_date from xc_period where name =  :v_current_period)
   and quota_effective_end.end_date >= (select start_date from xc_period where name =  :v_current_period)

control_4.xSQL:
select earning_group_name,Sum(amount) sum_amount_clean, FormatNumber(sum_amount_clean,'#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)') sum_amount, 'BONUS' component_name from xc_payment p1 
inner join xc_period c_period on p1.period_id = c_period.period_id
inner join xc_period c_period_q on c_period.parent_period_id = c_period_q.period_id
where 
	participant_id = :v_master_participant_id 
    and c_period_q.name = LookupPeriodName(incentive_date,'QUARTERLY') 
    and earning_Group_name like '%Bonus%'
	and c_period_q.name = :v_current_quarter
  	and c_period.end_date <= (select end_date from xc_period where name = :v_current_period)

control_5.xSQL:
select earning_group_name, SeqNum() ord from (
select distinct xq.name, Replace(Replace(xq.name,'ATV ',''), ' Weighting','') earning_group_name, xp_y.name y_name, xqa.amount, Max(Now()) scalar_funciton
from xc_quota_assignment xqa 
  inner join xc_quota xq on xqa.quota_id = xq.quota_id
  inner join xc_period xp_y on xqa.period_id = xp_y.period_id 
  inner join xc_period xp_q on xp_q.parent_period_id = xp_y.period_id
  inner join xc_period xp_m on xp_m.parent_period_id = xp_q.period_id
  inner join xc_period quota_effective_start on xqa.effective_start_period_id = quota_effective_start.period_id
  inner join xc_period quota_effective_end on xqa.effective_end_period_id = quota_effective_end.period_id
  
where xq.name like 'ATV%' 
 	and assignment_id = :v_master_position_id --'261661244'
    and xp_m.name = :v_current_period --'DEC-2024' 
    and quota_effective_start.start_date <= (select end_date from xc_period where name = :v_current_period)
    and quota_effective_end.end_date >= (select start_date from xc_period where name = :v_current_period) 
 	
order by xqa.amount desc)
where earning_group_name <> 'MBO'
